phone.simulatorNote: this is a web page, not a phone call

ready.title: Be the patient
ready.body: Give a missed call. We call you back and ask a few questions.
ready.promise: Phone numbers leave the reminder system 7 days after the course.

waiting.title: We will call you back
waiting.body: Keep this page open. The phone will ring.

record.title: Your answer
record.tapHint: Or tap once to start, tap again to send.

mic.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or skip this question.
mic.insecure: This page needs a secure address (https) to use the microphone. Skip this question.
mic.none: No microphone was found. Skip this question.
mic.busy: The microphone is in use by another app.

ended.title: The call ended
ended.body: Any answers you gave reached the dashboard, marked simulated.

dropped.title: Call dropped
dropped.body: The connection to the phone was lost.

err.busy: All the demo phones are in use. Try again in a minute.
err.full: You already have as many phones open as are allowed. Close one first.
err.off: The browser phone is switched off on this server.
err.tooMany: Too many missed calls in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.

phone.stoppedRinging: The call stopped ringing. Give a missed call to try again.

audio.blocked: Sound is blocked in this browser.

captions.off: The words of this call are not available.
captions.englishOff: The English words of this call are not available.
